capabilities.label: Baseline audio playback
capabilities.fallback: Use the device default output and supported common codec.

capabilities.label: Microphone capture and speech input
capabilities.fallback: Keep text input available; never bypass a denied permission.

capabilities.label: Text-to-speech and voice output
capabilities.fallback: Use OS/browser speech synthesis when available, otherwise display text.

capabilities.label: Noise control, echo handling, mixer and loudness processing
capabilities.fallback: Use conservative default gain; do not claim studio mixing or mastering.

capabilities.label: Spatial audio and surround
capabilities.fallback: Downmix to safe stereo when spatial output is unavailable.

capabilities.label: Dolby Atmos playback or authoring
capabilities.fallback: Use supported multichannel or stereo output; never label it Atmos.

capabilities.label: Cross-device video playback
capabilities.fallback: Select a widely supported rendition or offer a clear unsupported-format message.

capabilities.label: Adaptive bitrate and network resilience
capabilities.fallback: Use a lower supported rendition or graceful retry; do not claim adaptive streaming without a manifest/player.

capabilities.label: 4K/UHD picture
capabilities.fallback: Use the highest verified supported resolution and report the selected rendition.

capabilities.label: HDR10 picture
capabilities.fallback: Use SDR or tone-mapped playback when supported; don't claim HDR output without display-path evidence.

capabilities.label: Dolby Vision picture
capabilities.fallback: Use supported HDR10 or SDR rendition; never label it Dolby Vision.

capabilities.label: Captions, transcript and accessible controls
capabilities.fallback: Expose available transcript/text and retain accessible playback controls.
